items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023

ctx.x: written in and that’s it. He could not improvise whatsoever. So it was just — so when I’d go into a bridge for another tune he was completely lost, he goes like what’s he doing or what’s going on. And then I’d come out of that eight into the last eight of the tune, into the melody of the song we were playing. You know I wasn’t improvising I just played another bridge because I didn’t know it at the time.

Yeah I was. But you know what? It was a great experience, it really was. To this day, sometimes but I mean when you think about it, now think about all these tunes, you could play so many bridges are so similar, it goes back to the, you know to the last eight of the tune so I mean, I mean, well you know exactly what I’m talking about.
